scientific_integrity: Established random-telegraph coherence formulas, the unital-qubit entanglement-breaking criterion, and the prior qualitative result of finite revivals in the presence of relaxation are credited. The assessed contribution concerns exact per-lobe disappearance thresholds, their global strict ordering, and the Lambert-law two-term revival-count asymptotic versus the static-noise scaling. No independent audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas assume a stationary symmetric telegraph process with one fixed dephasing axis and an independently composed isotropic Markovian qubit depolarizer. The asymptotics fix the telegraph switching rate, are not uniform as that rate approaches zero, and concern channel entanglement breaking rather than a chosen input state. Finite numerical checks do not establish the infinite-family claims.
title: Exact revival thresholds and a logarithmic counting law for telegraph-noisy qubit channels
